source.name: sportsdataverse-data ESPN college-football player box
source.identity: ESPN athlete_id — the same backbone football/players/ already joins on, so nothing here is name-matched

tackles.basis: an FBS team makes 60-70 tackles a game. Below 40 the column is being filled in for some games and not others.

solo_tackles.basis: roughly half of all tackles are solo

tackles_for_loss.basis: an FBS team records 5-6 tackles for loss a game

sacks.basis: an FBS team records about 2 sacks a game

passes_defended.basis: an FBS team records about 3 passes defended a game

hurries.basis: hurries run 2-3 per team-game where the column is filled. This is a PRESSURE SHORT OF A SACK — the thing the player layer used to declare unobservable.

interceptions.basis: FBS interception rate is around 0.8 per team-game

punting.basis: an FBS team punts 4-5 times a game

field_goals.basis: an FBS team attempts about 1.5 field goals a game

qbr.basis: one rated quarterback per team-game is the most there can be

note: games is the count of distinct games this player appeared in the box score for. It is DIRECT PARTICIPATION evidence — not a snap count, which no public feed carries, but a far better role signal than touch share alone.
